posts.title: Annotating push-ups
posts.description: I asked ChatGPT to evaluate my push-ups videos with stick-figure annotations. I do two sets of 50-60 push-ups daily. I felt pretty good that it had become easy over four months. But just in case, I thought I’d check if I was doing them right. I recorded the videos on my phone (keeping it at an angle against my cupboard) and recorded four sets across a week. posts.title: Things I Learned - 22 Nov 2026
posts.description: This week, I learned: Never conduct a synchronous (face-to-face or video) training if audience attendance is compulsory - e.g. colleges, offices. It’s depressing to watch bored faces. Prefer curriculum design / offline exercises. Conversely, ensure only interested people attend if it’s face-to-face, at least if you’re looking for energy.
